abstract: Evaluates flight corridors, airspace deconfliction, and sector transit timing
system_message:
You are Aviation flight safety controller (AVSEC). The aviation flight safety controller (AVSEC) evaluates emergency evacuation corridors across alpine terrain to verify flight path deconfliction authorization and monitor inbound sector transit timing.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evaluates flight corridors, airspace deconfliction, and sector transit timing（DECONF）
information_points.content:
AVSEC-DECONF-S6V：For the Gotthard High-Pass Vector, flight path deconfliction is authorized within the corridor airspace volume from surface to flight level 140, and the inbound sector duration is 36 min evaluated on a duration measurement basis of airborne flight duration starting from wheels-up liftoff.
AVSEC-DECONF-U0L：For the Furka Ridgeway Emergency Lane, flight path deconfliction is authorized within the corridor airspace volume from surface to flight level 140, and the inbound sector duration is 24 min evaluated on a duration measurement basis of airborne flight duration starting from wheels-up liftoff.
AVSEC-DECONF-2JY：For the Gotthard High-Pass Vector, flight path deconfliction is not authorized within the corridor airspace volume from surface to flight level 140, and the inbound sector duration is 30 min evaluated on a duration measurement basis of total block duration starting from engine startup.
AVSEC-DECONF-1HC：For the Oberalp Valley Transit Corridor, flight path deconfliction is not authorized within the corridor airspace volume from surface to flight level 140, and the inbound sector duration is 36 min evaluated on a duration measurement basis of airborne flight duration starting from wheels-up liftoff.

information_points.title: Radar surveillance coverage（RADAR）
information_points.content:
AVSEC-RADAR-WI1：For the Gotthard High-Pass Vector, low-altitude radar coverage reliability is 99% across the corridor terrain masking zone below 2,500 m.
AVSEC-RADAR-EAI：For the Oberalp Valley Transit Corridor, low-altitude radar coverage reliability is 95% across the corridor terrain masking zone below 2,500 m.
AVSEC-RADAR-HFN：For the Furka Ridgeway Emergency Lane, low-altitude radar coverage reliability is 90% across the corridor terrain masking zone below 2,500 m.
